heading: Let the anonymous page read the key from the link
replaces: The acceptance page belongs to an anonymous actor, so it is reached without signing in. The platform's guest-page hook (`supportGuestAccess`) only governs what an unauthenticated visitor sees at the root; this entry's page is an anonymous actor's own app. It reads the key from the query parameter of the link, and sends the key with each API call so the backend can find the invitation. Register one request interceptor for this (the generated frontend uses an axios request interceptor for header enrichment, see the platform's advanced patterns), not one per call. The key-in-URL scheme is common practice.
proposed: The acceptance page belongs to an anonymous actor, so it is reached without signing in. The generated app of an actor without a principal has no sign-in: it creates no OIDC provider, no `Auth` wrapper and no token interceptor, and the metamodel marks `supportGuestAccess` as applicable only to actors that are not anonymous. An actor with a principal, even an unmapped one, gets the sign-in wrapper instead. The page reads the key from the query parameter of the link, and sends the key with each API call so the backend can find the invitation. Register one request interceptor for this in the project's `custom` folder, which runs before the app renders, not one per call. The key-in-URL scheme is common practice.

heading: ## Frontend Build Recovery
proposed: **Known issue: UI validation errors print as `{}: {}`.** The UI validation step logs through `StringBuilderLogger`, which formats messages with `String.format`. Slf4j-style `{}` placeholders are not replaced, so each failing UI constraint is logged as the bare line `{}: {}` with no constraint name or message. The Java validator path (`UiJavaValidator`) logs this way; the build reaches it when the Epsilon UI executor cannot be loaded, and then logs `Validator class ... not found. Using fallback.` Workaround: run `judo-cli -m <model-path> validate`, which prints each UI finding as `error ui <constraint> <element>: <message>`, and fix the reported constraints. Platform fix: format the placeholders in `StringBuilderLogger` the way slf4j does.
